title: Kitchen Line (Seven Feet Of Patient Time)
style: viral pop anthem, 122 BPM, hip hop pop, stadium claps, male and female duet, paddle-tap percussion, referee whistle SFX, big chant chorus, sport-anthem energy, hooky earworm, festival pop, sing-along
lyrics:
[Intro — referee whistle, crowd hum]
Foot fault on the line.
Replay the point.
Stay behind the seven feet.

[Verse 1 — male lead, easy pop swagger]
Stepped across the line, didn't mean to go
Two-bounce rule said wait, but my paddle moved low
Came in driving hard, tried to seal the rally
The ref called the foot, now I'm walking down the alley

[Pre-Chorus — building chant]
You can stand on the line
You can sit on the line
You just can't volley on the line
That's the only rule that holds the line!

[Chorus — viral chant, stadium claps]
KITCHEN LINE! KITCHEN LINE!
Seven feet of patient time
KITCHEN LINE! KITCHEN LINE!
One foot wrong, you lose the line!

[Verse 2 — female lead, smooth flow]
Soft hands, gentle drop, third-shot finesse
Reset the point, make the driver confess
Around the post she goes, the angle's looking spicy
Land it past the corner, paddle work is dicey

[Pre-Chorus]
You can stand on the line
You can sit on the line
You just can't volley on the line
That's the only rule that holds the line!

[Chorus]
KITCHEN LINE! KITCHEN LINE!
Seven feet of patient time
KITCHEN LINE! KITCHEN LINE!
One foot wrong, you lose the line!

[Bridge — slowed]
Momentum carried me, my paddle was warm
The ball was high, I should have held my form
But I leaned in, I crossed the line
The kitchen don't forgive, the kitchen don't rewind

[Verse 3 — duet, rapid-fire]
[male] Cross-court drop!
[female] Down the middle!
[male] Reset the point!
[female] Solve the riddle!
[both] Patient hands and a quiet wrist
[both] Behind the line, and never miss!

[Final Chorus — full crowd]
KITCHEN LINE! KITCHEN LINE!
Seven feet of patient time
KITCHEN LINE! KITCHEN LINE!
One foot wrong, you lose the line!

[Outro — referee voice]
Score is now eleven serving four.
Stay behind the line.
Game on.
